engineer_user_rating.value: 4.4/5 (typical) — consultants value the complete per-shade performance tables and the DGU data; the Edge range is the usual answer when a client wants thermal insulation without a DGU

contractor_preference.value: High on apartment and commercial projects in Hyderabad where AIS processors supply toughened and DGU units; moderate at small window shops, where Saint-Gobain shades are more familiar

novice_preference.value: Moderate — known to home buyers mainly through AIS Windows and the AIS Glasxperts retail brand rather than by glass product name

project_vs_retail_cost_note.value: Project supply via AIS processors is typically 15–25% below retail counter rates; single-window retail orders carry cutting, wastage and transport charges

bulk_discount_note.value: Slabs generally start at one jumbo-equivalent (about 70–80 sqft of 6 mm) and improve at crate lots; shade-matched batches should be ordered together

dealer_margin_note.value: Distributor-to-dealer margins on coated architectural glass generally run 10–18%, processing (toughening, DGU) being a separate margin line

value.balanced: South India including Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, supplied through Chennai and Hyderabad processors

secondary_use.value: Low-rise commercial facades and structural glazing, and 6-12-6 DGUs for offices

special_use.value: Green-building (IGBC / GRIHA) projects where single-glazed thermal insulation with a neutral look is specified

short_description: AIS Ecosense Edge Natura Plus 6 mm neutral coated glass for single glazing. VLT 45%, SHGC 0.42, U-value 4.6 W/m²K. Sold per sqft, cut to size.
long_description:
## What it is

AIS Ecosense Edge Natura Plus is a 6 mm coated glass from Asahi India Glass's Ecosense range, in the Edge sub-range that AIS developed for single-glazing use. A multilayer metal-oxide coating on clear soda-lime float glass gives the pane both solar control and a measure of thermal insulation, which is why it is grouped here as a low-emissivity glass; the neutral shade keeps the view colour-true. It is supplied as one annealed monolithic pane, so it is not a safety glass as delivered, and a processor can toughen or laminate it to IS 2553 Part 1 if required. At about 15 kg per square metre, a 1200 × 1800 mm pane weighs roughly 32 kg.

## What it's for

Windows and residential glazing: large living-room sliders, bedroom windows and balcony glazing in houses and apartments across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and small façades and structural glazing on low-rise commercial buildings. It is rated for exterior use with the coated face to the interior; as supplied it is not meant for overhead glazing.

## Key specifications

For the 6 mm single pane AIS publishes a visible light transmission of 45%, external reflection of 20%, a solar factor of 42% (SHGC 0.42) and a U-value of 4.6 W/m²K, computed to ISO 9050 for light and solar values and EN 673 for the U-value. Emissivity is estimated at about 0.4, UV transmission around 20% and sound reduction about 31 dB. Thermal-shock resistance is 40 °C and bending strength 41 MPa, the usual values for annealed float. The substrate is IS 14900 float glass; IS 2553 Part 1 applies only once toughened or laminated, and IS 16231 only if the pane is built into the 6-12-6 DGU configuration AIS also lists.

## Installation notes

Glaze with the coating on surface 2 — the inside face of the outer pane — in uPVC or aluminium frames or structural-glazing systems, with at least 12 mm edge engagement, setting blocks and neutral-cure silicone. The coated annealed pane can be cut to size at the dealer; handle the coated face with clean gloves, keep it dry in storage and do not use abrasive pads on it. Order toughened panes for doors, railings and oversized lights.

## What's supplied

Cut-to-size panes with as-cut edges and the coated face marked, interleaved with paper or cork pads and delivered on an A-frame or in a wooden crate. Minimum order 10 sqft; typical lead time about 7 days through AIS processors in Hyderabad and Vijayawada. Warranty is recorded as 120 months on the coating, to be confirmed with the AIS dealer. HSN 7005, GST 18%.
